content.title: How Do I Choose the Right Criminal Defense Lawyer? (Avoid These Mistakes)
content.text: 👉 Learn more: https://www.davidpshapirolaw.com/when... 📞 Talk to a lawyer: https://www.davidpshapirolaw.com/cont... 🎥 What to expect: • What to Expect During Your Case Evaluation... 📈 Check our results: https://www.davidpshapirolaw.com/resu... ===Summary=== *How Do I Choose the Right Criminal Defense Lawyer? (Avoid These Mistakes)* David Shapiro identifies three critical mistakes people make when hiring a criminal defense attorney. The first mistake is assuming all attorneys are equal. While some attorneys may boast about having 40 or 50 years of experience, what matters more is their specific experience in criminal defense, particularly in the jurisdiction where the case will be heard. The speaker suggests that 15-20 years of high-quality criminal defense experience might be more valuable than 40-50 years of mediocre practice. The second mistake is focusing too much on cost savings. People often choose cheaper attorneys thinking they're saving money, but this short-term thinking can be detrimental. Instead, hiring a criminal defense attorney should be viewed as a long-term investment in one's future, considering how the decision will impact their life for years or decades to come. The third mistake is hiring an individual attorney rather than a law firm. When clients hire a solo practitioner, they may face limitations since that attorney must handle everything alone - from court appearances to administrative tasks. The speaker advocates for hiring a criminal defense law firm instead, where there's a team of attorneys and support staff available to handle various aspects of the case and provide consistent availability for client needs.
